stem.text: A ball of mass $200\,\text{g}$ is thrown horizontally with a speed of $20\,\text{m s}^{-1}$ against a vertical wall.
The ball is in contact with the wall for a time of $0.10\,\text{s}$ before rebounding back along its original path with a speed of $10\,\text{m s}^{-1}$.
What is the average force exerted by the wall on the ball during the collision?
